hunks.baseline: The Qi-Sea Acupoint.
hunks.sol: The qi-sea acupoint.

hunks.baseline: Its name meant “sea of qi,” which felt almost laughable. In that cramped vessel, more like a little stream than a sea, only a handful of murky energy rippled.
hunks.sol: Its name meant “sea of qi,” which felt almost laughable. In that cramped vessel, more like a little stream than a sea, only a handful of murky energy stirred.

hunks.baseline: That was right.
hunks.sol: That was how it had been.

hunks.baseline: It had definitely been that way.

> **System**
>
> An emergency Quest, **Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body**, has begun.
>
> **Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body** carries extreme risks. If anything goes wrong while the internal energy is being transferred and absorbed, it may lead to qi deviation or death.
hunks.sol:
> **System**
>
> An emergency Quest, **Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body**, has begun.
>
> **Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body** carries extreme risks. If anything goes wrong while internal energy is being transferred and absorbed, it may lead to qi deviation or death.

hunks.baseline: As the System’s notification gradually faded into the distance, my consciousness sank deep into my body.
hunks.sol: As the System notification faded from my ears, my consciousness sank deep into my body.

hunks.baseline: The world that spread before my eyes as they opened anew within it was an endless ocean.
hunks.sol: When my eyes opened within that world, an endless ocean stretched before me.

hunks.baseline: It was immeasurable. And hot.
hunks.sol: It stretched beyond sight. And it was hot.

hunks.baseline: Instead of clear blue waves, waves of fire surged without end.
hunks.sol: Instead of clear blue water, waves of fire surged without end.

hunks.baseline: And at its center, a gigantic fire dragon lay coiled atop a reef as black as pitch.
hunks.sol: At its center, a gigantic fire dragon lay coiled atop a reef as black as pitch.

hunks.baseline: In this place, filled with nothing but flames and heat, the reef where the fire dragon had made its home stood out as something especially alien.
hunks.sol: In a place filled with nothing but flame and heat, the reef beneath the fire dragon stood out as something alien.

hunks.baseline: Though decades of imprisonment and torture had worn him down, leaving him with far less internal energy than his old reputation suggested, perhaps that was why Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body had succeeded without killing me.
hunks.sol: Decades of imprisonment and torture had worn him down, leaving him with far less internal energy than his old reputation suggested. Perhaps that was why Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body had succeeded without killing me.

hunks.baseline: And the Heavenly Power Demon’s energy, which I’d inherited back then, had remained inside me ever since.
hunks.sol: The Heavenly Power Demon’s energy had remained inside me ever since.

hunks.baseline: That energy served as the nest of the fire dragon, the very embodiment of Scorching Yang Qi born of the Fire Gate Clan’s martial arts.
hunks.sol: It had become the nest of the fire dragon—the very embodiment of the Scorching Yang Qi born of the Fire Gate Clan’s martial arts.

hunks.baseline: It was a fairly harmonious coexistence, even a symbiosis. But in that moment, I instinctively understood.
hunks.sol: The two had coexisted well enough. They had even sustained each other. But now I instinctively understood something.

hunks.baseline: An unseen vibration swept across the ocean of flames. It reached the fire dragon, sleeping peacefully atop the reef at its center.
hunks.sol: An unseen vibration swept across the ocean of flames and reached the fire dragon sleeping peacefully atop the reef.

hunks.baseline: The fire dragon’s massive body trembled. Between its finally lifted eyelids, pale blue eyes appeared—and fixed directly on me.
hunks.sol: Its massive body trembled. At last, its eyelids lifted, revealing blue-white eyes fixed directly on me.

hunks.baseline: Slitted vertically, the eyes of a vicious beast.
hunks.sol: The vertically slit eyes of a vicious beast.

hunks.baseline: But the emotion within them wasn’t anger at being woken. It was obedience to its master.
hunks.sol: But there was no anger in them at being woken. Only obedience to their master.

hunks.baseline: The fire dragon and the reef were both, in the end, part of this ocean.
hunks.sol: Both the fire dragon and the reef were part of this ocean.

hunks.baseline: And the master of this vast world deep inside my body was none other than me.
hunks.sol: And the master of this vast world deep inside my body was me.

hunks.baseline: So, the instant our eyes met, that tremendous concentration of Scorching Yang Qi joined with my consciousness.
hunks.sol: The instant our eyes met, that tremendous concentration of Scorching Yang Qi joined with my consciousness.

hunks.baseline: Warmth and consciousness mingled.
hunks.sol: Warmth mingled with my mind.

hunks.baseline: My vision had turned pale blue. One with the fire dragon, I flung out both arms without hesitation.
hunks.sol: My vision turned blue-white. One with the fire dragon, I flung out both arms without hesitation.

hunks.baseline: The reef shook as though an earthquake had struck. With a shockwave, I shot into the air and drew a great breath high above.
hunks.sol: The reef shook as though an earthquake had struck. With a shockwave, I shot into the air and drew a deep breath high above it.

hunks.baseline: If it hadn’t been mine, that appalling heat rising from deep inside my body and racing up to my throat would have turned my whole body to ash long ago.
hunks.sol: Appalling heat surged from deep inside my body and raced up to my throat. If it hadn’t been mine, it would have reduced me to ash long ago.

hunks.baseline: There was no hesitation. With the breath I finally released, pale blue flames burst forth and wrapped around the reef.
hunks.sol: I didn’t hesitate. With the breath I released, blue-white flames burst forth and wrapped around the reef.

hunks.baseline: Then it was swept up by the waves of fire surging all around, rising high into the air. Having just breathed out a torrent of hellfire, I opened my mouth toward it.
hunks.sol: The waves of fire surging all around swept it up into the air. Having breathed out that torrent of hellfire, I opened my mouth toward it.

hunks.baseline: The moment I swallowed the liquid, its color a dark crimson from the melted reef—
hunks.sol: The moment I swallowed the dark-red liquid into which the reef had melted—

hunks.baseline: Suddenly, I couldn’t breathe. It was as if invisible blades were savagely carving through my insides.
hunks.sol: My breath caught. It felt as though invisible blades were savagely carving through my insides.

hunks.baseline: Before I could feel any satisfaction at the thirst that had finally been quenched, a sharp pain assailed my mind.
hunks.sol: Sharp pain assailed my mind before I could take any satisfaction in having quenched my thirst.

hunks.baseline: I steadied my wavering mind and used all my strength to swallow back the energy surging up my throat.
hunks.sol: I steadied my wavering mind and used all my strength to swallow back what was rising up my throat.

hunks.baseline: So it could never return to its original form.
hunks.sol: So it could never regain its original form.

hunks.baseline: So it could melt into me anew.
hunks.sol: So it could dissolve into me anew.

hunks.baseline: And for that, my endurance and choice were soon rewarded.
hunks.sol: My endurance and that choice were soon rewarded.

hunks.baseline: The power swelling inside me.
hunks.sol: Power swelling inside me.

hunks.baseline: The reef—or rather, the Heavenly Power Demon’s energy—hadn’t disappeared.
hunks.sol: The reef—or rather, the Heavenly Power Demon’s energy—hadn’t vanished.

hunks.baseline: It had been absorbed, and yet in another sense, it was a new kind of coexistence.
hunks.sol: I had absorbed it. In another sense, we had found a new way to coexist.

hunks.baseline: Unlike before, when it had been imperfect, now it had melted together into one. A perfect coexistence.
hunks.sol: Before, that coexistence had been imperfect. Now the two energies had dissolved fully into one.

hunks.baseline: And at the end of this astonishing change, something else was beginning.
hunks.sol: And with that astonishing change, something else began.

hunks.baseline: The world, all red with flames, flashed.
hunks.sol: The world, red with flame, flashed.

hunks.baseline: A massive bolt of lightning split open the closed sky and pierced through the ocean of flames.
hunks.sol: A massive bolt of lightning split open the closed sky and pierced the ocean of flames.

hunks.baseline: Before I could fully feel the change in my power, a genuine exclamation escaped me.
hunks.sol: Before I could fully feel the change in my power, an exclamation escaped me.

hunks.baseline: It was lightning, in the truest sense of the word.
hunks.sol: It was a thunderbolt in the truest sense of the word.

hunks.baseline: The end of a long and fierce life.
The symbol of a giant standing at death’s door, and the final legacy he’d hoped to leave in this world through me.
hunks.sol: At the end of a long, fierce life, it was the symbol of a giant standing at death’s door—and the final legacy he meant to leave in this world through me.

hunks.baseline: As that massive bolt of lightning finally entered deep into my body through the Great Palace Acupoint, I moved toward it as if entranced.
hunks.sol: As that massive bolt finally entered deep into my body through the Great Palace acupoint, I moved toward it as if entranced.

hunks.baseline: I followed it upward and upward, the current joining sea to sky.
hunks.sol: I followed it upward and upward, along the current joining sea to sky.

hunks.baseline: The sound of the fierce wind.
hunks.sol: The fierce wind.

hunks.baseline: Everything I felt through the fire dragon’s massive body, which had long since come to feel like my own.
hunks.sol: Everything I felt through the fire dragon’s massive body, which already felt as though it had always been mine.

hunks.baseline: My consciousness raced into the depths, perceiving everything as reality. I had risen so high that the ocean was no longer visible, and at last I saw it.
hunks.sol: Deep within my body, my consciousness perceived it all as real. I rose until the ocean vanished from sight, and at last I saw it.

hunks.baseline: A gigantic mountain rising like it would pierce the sky.
hunks.sol: A gigantic mountain rising as though it would pierce the sky.

hunks.baseline: And I already knew what that mountain was.
hunks.sol: I already knew what it was.

hunks.baseline: The mountain known as the Jade Hall Acupoint glittered like a jewel, just as its name suggested.
hunks.sol: The mountain known as the Jade Hall acupoint glittered like a jewel, just as its name suggested.

hunks.baseline: There was only one place that didn’t. The very highest peak.
hunks.sol: All but one part of it: the highest peak.

hunks.baseline: *Why? How come?*
hunks.sol: *Why?*

hunks.baseline: The question surfaced in my mind, but it disappeared as I found the answer myself.
hunks.sol: The question had barely surfaced before I found the answer.

hunks.baseline: *It means I’m still not ready.*
hunks.sol: *I’m still not ready.*

hunks.baseline: It had already been quite some time since I opened my Middle Dantian, but even my incredible pace of growth had its limits.
hunks.sol: It had been quite some time since I opened my Middle Dantian, but even my incredible pace of growth had its limits.

hunks.baseline: That mountain peak was the realm of enlightenment.
hunks.sol: That peak belonged to the realm of enlightenment.

hunks.baseline: A realm only those with heaven-given talent, blood-soaked effort, and long years behind them could enter.
hunks.sol: A realm for those with heaven-given talent, years of grueling effort, and long lives spent pursuing it.

hunks.baseline: A lofty height I, too, could hardly aspire to, even after improving at a dazzling pace.
hunks.sol: Even after growing stronger at a dazzling pace, I couldn’t easily reach that height.

hunks.baseline: *If not now, when will I ever get another chance to try?*
hunks.sol: *If not now, when will I ever get another chance?*

hunks.baseline: I’d experienced countless strokes of good fortune, but heavenly fortune never came easily.
hunks.sol: I’d had countless strokes of good fortune, but heavenly fortune never came easily.

hunks.baseline: And a stroke of heavenly fortune someone had created while prepared to die was an opportunity I’d never see again.
hunks.sol: And an opportunity created by someone prepared to die was one I would never see again.

hunks.baseline: Maybe my hesitation had vanished the moment this all began. The System’s warning no longer mattered.
hunks.sol: Maybe my hesitation had vanished the moment all this began. Maybe the System’s warning had lost its meaning then, too.

hunks.baseline: I’d already swallowed the Heavenly Power Demon’s energy. I already knew what I had to do.
hunks.sol: I had swallowed the Heavenly Power Demon’s energy. I knew what I had to do.

hunks.baseline: A bolt of lightning continued to shine without fading.
hunks.sol: The bolt of lightning kept shining, refusing to fade.

hunks.baseline: I leaped toward its massive pillar of light.
hunks.sol: I leaped into its massive pillar of light.

hunks.baseline: Everything before me turned white. The agony was incomparable to when I absorbed the Heavenly Power Demon’s energy. It squeezed every muscle in my body and vaporized my consciousness.
hunks.sol: Everything turned white. Agony beyond anything I’d felt while absorbing the Heavenly Power Demon’s energy wrung every muscle in my body and burned away my consciousness.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t know. I didn’t know where I was.
hunks.sol: I didn’t know where I was.

hunks.baseline: All I could do, as my consciousness grew hazy, was hear someone’s thunderous shout.
hunks.sol: As my consciousness grew hazy, all I heard was someone’s thunderous shout.

hunks.baseline: The instant that unmistakably Jeok Cheongang-like shout rang out—
hunks.sol: The instant Jeok Cheongang’s unmistakable voice rang out—

hunks.baseline: My consciousness, sinking fast, awakened.
hunks.sol: My rapidly sinking consciousness snapped awake.

hunks.baseline: Strength flowed into my limp, powerless body. Memories of reality, long forgotten, returned.
hunks.sol: Strength returned to my limp body. Memories of reality came back to me.

hunks.baseline: What I had to do for everyone who’d believed in me, a callow, inadequate brat.
hunks.sol: What I had to do for everyone who had believed in me, a callow, inadequate brat.

hunks.baseline: I bore the unceasing pain tearing through my body with all my strength.
hunks.sol: With all my strength, I bore the pain that kept tearing through my body.

hunks.baseline: I mustered the Scorching Yang Qi at the fire dragon’s core and the Heavenly Power Demon’s energy I’d just absorbed, down to the last ounce of strength I could summon, and bit into the pillar of lightning.
hunks.sol: I mustered the Scorching Yang Qi within the fire dragon and the Heavenly Power Demon’s energy I’d just absorbed. Drawing on every last scrap of strength, I bit into the pillar of lightning.

hunks.baseline: Lightning flashed before my eyes. Everything belonging to a giant was contained in that energy. That lightning, holding everything the giant had been, was numbing my mind past the point of pain.
hunks.sol: Lightning flashed before my eyes. It held everything that giant had been, and now it was numbing my mind beyond the point of pain.

hunks.baseline: *Fuck, it’s not like I’ve never shit blood before.*
hunks.sol: *Fuck, I’ve shit blood plenty of times.*

hunks.baseline: At some point, I was laughing like a madman.
hunks.sol: At some point, I started laughing like a madman.

hunks.baseline: I bit into the lightning, swallowed it, and kept going without pause, even as I nearly blacked out from the pain I’d known was coming.
hunks.sol: I bit into the lightning, swallowed it, and kept going without pause, even when the pain I knew was coming nearly made me black out.

hunks.baseline: Until the distant flash that had filled my vision slowly dimmed.
hunks.sol: Until the blinding light filling my vision slowly dimmed.

hunks.baseline: And at last, until it vanished completely, as if it had never existed.
hunks.sol: Until at last it vanished completely, as though it had never existed.

hunks.baseline: Suddenly, through my hazy consciousness, I realized:
hunks.sol: Through my hazy consciousness, I realized something.

hunks.baseline: The massive bolt of lightning that had connected my Middle and Lower Dantians was no longer there.
hunks.sol: The massive bolt of lightning that had connected my Middle and Lower Dantians was gone.

hunks.baseline: The thunder I could hear from somewhere was ringing out inside me.
hunks.sol: The thunder I heard was ringing inside me.

hunks.baseline: The moment I faced the truth of Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body’s success—
hunks.sol: The moment I understood that Transmitting Internal Energy Across the Body had succeeded—

hunks.baseline: From far off in my consciousness, clear chimes began ringing without pause.
hunks.sol: Clear chimes began ringing without pause, somewhere far off in my consciousness.

hunks.baseline: But the sound hadn’t come from the ocean of the Lower Dantian, now far in the distance, or from the peak of the Middle Dantian, finally glowing like a brilliant jewel.
hunks.sol: But they hadn’t come from the ocean of the Lower Dantian, now far below me, or from the peak of the Middle Dantian, finally shining like a brilliant jewel.

hunks.baseline: I raised my head and saw it.
hunks.sol: I raised my head and saw them.

hunks.baseline: Clouds the mountain peak couldn’t reach.
hunks.sol: Clouds beyond the mountain peak’s reach.

hunks.baseline: Another world, hidden behind those clouds.
hunks.sol: Another world hidden behind them.

hunks.baseline: *The Upper Dantian.*
hunks.sol: *The upper dantian.*

hunks.baseline: I was thirsty. As soon as I achieved my goal, the threadbare strands of my consciousness began to grow clearer.
hunks.sol: I was thirsty. With my goal achieved, my consciousness, which had nearly unraveled to a thread, began to grow clearer.

hunks.baseline: It was thirst, and it was longing.
hunks.sol: It was thirst. Longing.

hunks.baseline: I wanted to pierce through those white clouds, soar above them, and look down on everything.
hunks.sol: I wanted to break through those white clouds, soar above them, and look down on everything.

hunks.baseline: But I had to force down that burning thirst and longing.
hunks.sol: But I forced down that burning thirst and longing.

hunks.baseline: I’d reached my limit.
hunks.sol: I was already at my limit.

hunks.baseline: I already knew what consequences this fleeting impulse would bring.
hunks.sol: I knew what this momentary impulse would bring.

hunks.baseline: And for the first time, I faced the essence contained within the three currents of energy, now united, and the vast power they formed together.
hunks.sol: For the first time, I faced the essence within the three currents of energy, now united, and the vast power they formed.

hunks.baseline: I floundered in my distant consciousness.
hunks.sol: My mind drifted. I floundered in it.

hunks.baseline: —A wise choice. Just like back then.
hunks.sol: —A good choice. Just like back then.

hunks.baseline: A voice that felt unfamiliar, yet strangely familiar, as though I’d heard it somewhere before.
hunks.sol: The voice felt unfamiliar, yet somehow familiar, as though I’d heard it before.
